name: SOC-004: Windows Defense Evasion Detected
description: Detects Windows defense evasion techniques including Event Log clearing, Windows Defender disabling, Shadow Copy deletion, and Audit Policy tampering.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%wevtutil%cl%' OR payload ILIKE '%Clear-EventLog%' OR payload ILIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' OR payload ILIKE '%vssadmin%delete%shadows%' OR payload ILIKE '%wmic%shadowcopy%delete%' OR payload ILIKE '%auditpol%/clear%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
